first.rationale: Current state shows concurrent declines in both activation (6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ), with memory_86 and memory_91 establishing that onboarding simplification and activation messaging both drive early adoption. memory_31 demonstrated durable first-week activation lift from field reduction at signup. Verifying memory_31 (signup simplification) and memory_73 (promotional pricing) addresses the two most plausible levers: whether signup friction reduction remains effective in current conditions, and whether pricing intervention is warranted against competitive pressure. Onboarding simplification is prioritized because: (1) it directly targets the measured onboarding completion decline, (2) the inherited evidence is strong and specific (memory_86 shows completion and adoption lift), (3) it has lower execution risk than pricing changes, (4) it generates sustainable behavioral improvement rather than one-time acquisition. Promotional pricing would address competitor threat but risks margin and doesn't repair the internal activation metrics degradation. Referral incentives and enterprise sales assist are premature when core self-serve funnel health is declining. Standard_experiment scale allows rapid signal while controlling downside. Verification of memory_31 and memory_73 will clarify whether signup simplification remains effective and whether pricing is a necessary component of the response.

final.rationale: Verification confirmed memory_31 (signup simplification +9% activation, +4% qualified revenue on SMB) remains sound, with durable retention intact (-1% is acceptable). Critically, memory_73 verification revealed that targeted promotional pricing produces acquisition +31% but retention -12%, failing to return on renewal and directly contradicting sustainability objective. This disqualifies promotional_pricing despite competitive pressure. Current QoQ declines in onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%) align precisely with onboarding simplification's demonstrated impact. Signup field reduction worked; shortening onboarding flows (memory_86) and activation messaging (memory_91) both show measurable adoption lift. Running simplify_onboarding on SMB segment addresses the measured funnel degradation with lowest execution risk and highest confidence in sustainable outcome. Referral incentives and enterprise sales assist are orthogonal to current activation decline. Activation_messaging is plausible but onboarding simplification is the primary lever—completing flows drives engagement. Standard_experiment scale allows signal detection without overcommit on a single directional change.
